cohort: 259 women with primary postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) at an academic center between June 2015 and September 2017.
finding: Delay in administration of therapeutic uterotonics was associated with a higher incidence of hypotension and transfusion in primary PPH patients.
mod_finding: For vaginal deliveries, each 5-minute delay in uterotonic administration was associated with 31% and 34% higher odds of hypotension and transfusion, respectively.
